# `~`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
~ expr
```

Returns the result of bitwise NOT of `expr`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `bitwise_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples
